title: NFL Football
description:
Jacksonville Jaguars at Cincinnati Bengals
The Bengals host the Jaguars in NFL Week 4 at Paycor Stadium. In their last meeing, Cincinnati beat Jacksonville, 31-27, last September. The Jaguars routed the Patriots, 35-6, while the Bengals fell, 30-27, to the Steelers in last week's action.

title: NFL Football
description:
Kansas City Chiefs at Las Vegas Raiders
The Las Vegas Raiders host the Kansas City Chiefs at Allegiant Stadium in NFL Week 4. Both teams are unbeaten, sitting atop the AFC West. Las Vegas claimed the last meeting, a 14-12 victory in the last game of the regular season on January 4.
